title: Usage alerts and quieter launches.
summary: Optional usage alerts, snooze controls and Start in background for Windows.

sections.title: Usage alerts
items: Turn on optional Windows notifications for Codex and Claude Code. Usage alerts start off, with individually editable thresholds at 75, 90 and 95 percent used.
Choose distinct whole percentages from 1 to 100 and enable each provider or threshold separately. Alerts warn about usage; they do not stop agents or limit spending.
Warnings use eligible, verified usage readings and reported reset times. Handled thresholds stay remembered across restarts with intact local alert state.
Send a test notification from Settings and check notification availability. Windows notification controls and Do Not Disturb still apply.

sections.title: Alert snooze
items: Snooze alerts for one hour or until tomorrow at 09:00 local time, or resume them early. Settings shows the saved snooze deadline.
Monitoring continues during snooze. Reached thresholds establish a silent baseline when snooze ends, including after sleep, offline time or restart, so alerts do not deliver a backlog.
Test notifications remain available during snooze and do not consume usage thresholds.

sections.title: Start in background
items: Choose whether ordinary launches open the main window. Start in background is initially off and is separate from Launch at Startup; login launches remain quiet.
First-time setup remains visible, and opening Llumi again restores the existing window. Changing the preference applies to future launches.
With the tray icon disabled, background launches retain a minimized taskbar window. Closing keeps monitoring active; Quit exits Llumi.
